text: Now here's something that'll blow your mind - Stanford researchers have cracked one of quantum computing's biggest problems. They've built a quantum device that uses twisted light and works at room temperature, no more need for extreme cooling.

speaker: alice
text: And get this - scientists discovered that caffeine can actually reverse memory problems caused by sleep deprivation. They found that being tired damages brain circuits responsible for recognising familiar faces, but caffeine restored communication between neurons.

speaker: charlie
text: So basically science is telling us that morning coffee really is essential for remembering who your mates are. I reckon half of Queensland just felt vindicated about their caffeine habits!
